family.description: Optional model family filter, for example mace, chgnet, matgl, sevennet, orb, mattersim, fairchem, nequip, or torchsim.

availableOnly.description: When true, only return model assets with an existing local model file.

includePackages.description: Include import/package availability for known MLIP runtimes.

verifyChecksum.description: Compute SHA-256 for local files and compare with manifest checksums. This may read large model files.

limit.description: Maximum number of model assets to return.
